study.question: Does deterministic target-routed mean content plus explicit exposure counts suffice without learned slot scoring, and how much of the previous routing gain comes from those counts rather than compressed content? Observed full-validation macro AUCs: baseline-din 0.8099233881; g2-r0000-target_early 0.8208558622; g2-r0000-position_early 0.8140881053; g2-r0000-target_late 0.8201101844; g2-r0000-position_late 0.8142016697. Target-vs-position early difference is +0.0067677569, but target early-vs-late is only +0.0007456778 and position early-vs-late -0.0001135644. Thus early compression is not uniformly more accurate. Long-history (>64) target early-vs-position early macro difference is +0.0129585915, while 1..16 difference is +0.0016492368; these exploratory slices motivate testing count accumulation, not a claim of mechanism. Empty-history target early macro AUC 0.7142002336 is below baseline 0.7268428930 on just 6444 examples (45/28/13 cart/fav/buy positives), so global gains are not universal.
study.hypothesis: Within the frozen offline benchmark, eight deterministic target-match/recency partitions already provide the useful conditioning; an ungated mean-content-plus-count representation can retain or improve validation macro AUC while avoiding the eight learned local-activation evaluations. Explicit match counts may explain much of the auxiliary-task gain, a competing explanation that would weaken any claim that early compression preserves useful learned event content. Content and count complementarity is a separate testable possibility, not an assumed outcome.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary paper sections4.2/4.3, lines220..277 inspected: group sum/mean pooling and unnormalized target-conditioned local activation are existing ideas. Candidate keeps deterministic target-dependent group membership but removes learned within-slot scalar scoring. No new pooling/attention priority claim and no exact DIN reproduction claim.

Exact ancestor source digest verified against runtime. Reuse its eight target-category/brand-match x recency slots and joint context/target readouts; replace only learned slot weights with one. Other variants zero the explicit content/count paths; this is a simplification and attribution study, not a new grouping algorithm.

Pinned benchmark lines81..86 and112..158 use full-resolution target attention before global/group tokenization and reversible mixing. Candidate uses deterministic disjoint event routing and means before readout, without learned target attention or token mixing. Original TokenMixer paper was not audited; no superiority or comprehensive novelty claim.

Pinned benchmark lines80..85 and113..159 use target-attention aggregation and heterogeneous field/task token interaction. Candidate retains ordinary joint MLP readouts to isolate history statistics; it introduces no hierarchical interaction block. Original HiFormer paper was not audited.

Only author README was accessible and read; it warns that its behavior data has category, brand and behavior type but no item ID. Here histories include real advertisement fields. The blocked paper supplies no verified mechanism comparison; no DMR transfer or priority claim.

inherited_components: All candidate architecture from g2-r0000-target_early except the explicitly declared information-path interventions; no change to module allocation or initialization order.
FeatureEmbeddingDict, item plus action history values, shared bias-free slot projection, eight counts divided by100, four Dice MLP task heads.
Disjoint category/brand equality groups exclude zero IDs, crossed with older/last16 ordinal bands; last16 is not a time window.
Host information boundary, labels, four-task equal-weight selection, split and entire training recipe.
study.proposed_difference: uniform_summary uses unweighted masked mean values in each deterministic target slot instead of multiplying by the learned slot score. content_only retains parent learned content and zeroes explicit count inputs; counts_only zeroes slot content; no_history zeroes both. The existing g2-r0000-target_early is the full-content/full-count cell of a 2x2 factorial. All four files are standalone; CONFIG changes only architecture. Scorer and ablated columns stay registered to preserve initial allocation/RNG; their dormant capacity must be disclosed. Ablations retain upstream computation, so their measured speed is not the cost of an optimized counts-only deployment.
predictions: Predeclared directional candidate prediction: uniform_summary minus g2-r0000-target_early validation macro AUC >=0 and lower model-only batch latency. This is not a noninferiority margin; raw selection policy is unchanged. Report macro Logloss and every task delta against both parent and baseline-din.

If counts dominate the previous gain, counts_only will retain more parent advantage over no_history than content_only, especially for cart/fav/buy and >64 history. Compare (A_full-A_content_only) with (A_counts_only-A_no_history) and I=A_full-A_content_only-A_counts_only+A_no_history; A is macro AUC. Repeat taskwise and descriptively for macro Logloss with its direction reversed.

If content and counts are complementary, both removals decrease AUC and factorial interaction I may be positive; one-seed interaction is provisional and AUC nonlinearity prevents a causal information decomposition.

Re-use predefined empty,1..16,17..64,>64 bins with exact sample/positive/negative counts. Empty-history information streams are always zero; performance differences there reflect training/shared representations and sparse labels rather than recovered event content.
falsifiers: A repeatable negative uniform-minus-learned macro AUC difference falsifies the no-quality-loss simplification under this recipe. A single small difference is preliminary; report all task tradeoffs without a new per-task veto.
No measured latency/training reduction defeats an efficiency claim even if local scoring FLOPs are removed; embedding/loading/MLP costs may dominate.

If counts_only is close to full while content_only is close to no_history, retract a strong learned-history-retention explanation of the earlier routing gain and identify the benchmark-specific count explanation.

If content_only retains the gain and counts_only does not, reject count dominance; if both fail but full succeeds, investigate complementarity with paired repetitions rather than declaring one component sufficient.

Any change in predictions from target action/current-label inputs, invalid masked history payloads, or any nonfinite empty-history forward/backward is an implementation failure, not scientific counterevidence.
alternative_explanations: One original seed; same initialization is a paired contrast but does not establish seed robustness or statistical significance.
Unused channels and modules preserve allocated parameter count, not effective capacity or optimization geometry; dense decay and sparse history-gradient changes remain.
Slot content retains occupancy, matching categories/brands and finite-sample variance, so removing explicit counts does not remove every count-related signal.
Auxiliary labels are user/category/brand 24h outcomes, not advertisement-attributed conversions. Offline feedback maturity and snapshot assumptions remain inherited.
Ungating changes feature scale and regularization as well as removes learned scoring. A worse result would not prove all learned compression necessary.

No mask changes or extra events are introduced. Missing data and a blocked source are availability limits, not negative scientific results. All five existing trajectories executed successfully; late and position alternatives are retained as lower-scoring or null-direction evidence.

Existing target model uses 32140741 allocated parameters (347525 dense), versus DIN 32059429 (266213 dense). The original gain over DIN is not capacity-matched; new contrasts match allocated shapes but not active capacity.

variants.note: Replace learned eight-slot scalar scoring with weight one; retain target-routed mean item/action content and eight explicit counts. Registered scorer is dormant; no new parameters.

variants.name: content_only
variants.note: Parent learned content with eight explicit count channels zeroed; slot occupancy and sample-size effects implicit in content remain.

variants.name: counts_only
variants.note: Zero all 256 compressed-content coordinates; retain target/context embeddings and the eight target-match/recency counts. Upstream work and dormant parameters are retained for attribution.

variants.name: no_history
variants.note: Zero content and count coordinates. Target/context-only anchor completes content x explicit-count factorial with existing parent. Shared embedding learning changes when history gradients are removed.
